learning_outcomes.text: To give students practical skills and knowledge of the main machining processes, the machines and tools that are applied in them as well as various machining and assembling operations.

syllabus_topics: Organization, preparation and control of various machine tools, cutting tools, equipment and positioning of parts or cutting tools on machines
Independent work on a Milling machine
Independent work on a Drilling machine
Laying out parts in the bench department
Making a test part following a drawing
assessment_rules: Students’ knowledge is assessed through discussions, as well as during the practical and laboratory classes. The final grade is the result of a colloquium.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
